verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Carta's developer/API platform (cap table data retrieval, OAuth, MCP plugins, data warehouse) but contains no documentation of a scenario-modeling tool for priced rounds, dilution, option pool top-ups, SAFE conversion modeling, or pro-forma ownership sharing with counsel/investors. Only tangential API endpoints exist (cap table percentage calculation, convertible note listing, draft option grants) but none describe an interactive round-modeling workflow.
